title: AiStreamEvent
description: One line of an application/x-ndjson answer (Ghosted server/src/index.ts answer()). The stream starts with {"t":""} so proxies don't buffer, then {"t": new text}, {"s": status} while a tool works, {"reset": true} when a retry starts over, and ends with exactly one {"done": result} or {"error": message}. The result is identical to the non-streamed JSON body.

t.description: Text added since the last t line of this attempt.

reset.description: A retry started over: drop the text so far.

s.description: What a tool is doing right now ("Reading the posting").

done.description: The result, the same as the JSON body would be.

kind.description: Added by the kit; Ghosted's current server sends only error.
